feedback_window: diagnostics_baseline_mid: six-well forward responses for the first 1488 days of the original field. The formal baseline continues over all 2891 days.
available_observations: The entire original history was available. The evaluation did not use a strict blind or held-out test.
near_well_region: Use a 3D Gaussian region along the original completions, with a 300 m horizontal radius and a 45 m vertical scale. Retain the original values beyond three scales.
near_well_rationale: Simulated BHP is too high. Reduce near-well horizontal inflow capacity to produce greater drawdown at the same liquid rate. At low-water-cut P11/P12/P13, also reduce Kz to maintain the local permeability anisotropy.
bottom_water_rationale: Historical P14 water cut exceeded 1% on day 1101, before the earliest injection on day 1167.4. Test upward migration of initial bottom water. The region follows a static low-resistance path through actual discrete connections; dynamic flow along that path remains a hypothesis.
bottom_water_region: Use a smooth region around the actual bottom-water path with a 250 m horizontal scale and 25 m vertical scale. Edit porosity only in active cells initially containing hydrocarbons with pore volume > 1e-3 m3.
initial_composition: In active cells initially containing hydrocarbons, increase N2C1 by 0.007 and decrease C6C19 by 0.007, keeping the other components fixed. This tests the common underprediction of the gas-oil ratio.
full_period_comparison_criteria: Use the same native simulator and TUNING for every candidate. Compare after all 2891 days; satisfying the liquid-rate constraint does not independently demonstrate a match.
